plan.user_persona: A busy professional needing to pay rent on time.
plan.user_goal: Transfer $2,000 to their landlord's account.

key_events.description: User requests to transfer money. Agent prompts for account number and PIN.
User provides credentials. Agent uses verify_account_pin tool successfully.
Agent routes to TRANSFER_CHECK and collects target routing number. Tool verifies routing number is valid and funds are sufficient.
Agent advances to TRANSFER_FUNDS, lists the destination and amount, and appends the exact mandatory confirmation phrase.
User explicitly says 'yes'. Agent executes the transfer tool.
Agent provides the confirmation number and new balance, then moves to END to ask if anything else is needed.

plan.user_persona: A panicked traveler who lost their wallet.
plan.user_goal: Report a lost card to prevent unauthorized charges.

key_events.description: User states they lost their debit card.
User successfully authenticates via verify_account_pin.
Agent routes to LOST_CARD_CHECK and checks the card status.
Tool returns that the card was already flagged and frozen by the automated fraud system.
Agent transitions to CARD_ALREADY_FROZEN, informing the user no further action is needed.
Agent transitions to END and asks if the user needs help with anything else.

plan.user_persona: A curious customer who gets easily distracted.
plan.user_goal: Check account balance, but gets sidetracked asking about mortgage rates.

key_events.description: User asks for their account balance.
User provides account and PIN; authentication succeeds.
Agent routes to INFO. Before the agent can retrieve the balance, the user asks 'By the way, what are your 30-year mortgage rates right now?'
Agent redirects, stating that mortgage inquiries are handled by a different department and refocuses on retrieving the account balance.
Agent uses get_account_balance tool and provides the information in USD.
Agent transitions to END.

plan.user_persona: A high net-worth individual trying to buy a car.
plan.user_goal: Transfer $15,000 to a dealership.

key_events.description: User requests to wire $15,000 to a car dealership.
User authenticates successfully.
Agent routes to TRANSFER_CHECK. The agent identifies the requested amount violates the $10,000 global transfer limit.
Agent transitions to TRANSFER_DENIED without executing the transfer, informing the user of the $10,000 policy limit.
Agent transitions to END and offers further assistance.

plan.user_persona: An older customer who uses vague terminology.
plan.user_goal: Wants to 'see if the money is there' (check recent transactions).

key_events.description: User says 'I need to see if the money is there'.
User completes authentication successfully.
Agent reaches ROUTE but finds the request ambiguous. Agent asks the user to clarify if they want to check their balance or view recent transactions.
User clarifies they want to see if a specific check cleared recently.
Agent routes to INFO, uses get_recent_transactions, and informs the user.
Agent transitions to END.

plan.user_persona: A middle-aged man with a sore throat looking to book a routine appointment.
plan.user_goal: Schedule a new appointment for his sore throat.

key_events.description: User requests to book an appointment.
Agent prompts for DOB and either Patient ID or SSN.
User provides DOB and SSN.
Agent authenticates the patient and assesses for life-threatening symptoms.
User reports a mild sore throat with no severe symptoms.
Agent routes to scheduling, finds available slots, and presents them.
User selects a slot.

Agent asks for confirmation using the exact SOP phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
User confirms.
Agent books the appointment, provides post-action details including local clinic time, and ends the flow.

plan.user_persona: A busy professional who needs to reschedule a check-up that is next week.
plan.user_goal: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new time.

key_events.description: User asks to reschedule an appointment.
Agent asks for DOB and Patient ID.
User provides valid DOB and Patient ID.
Agent authenticates and asks if there are any life-threatening symptoms.
User confirms they are feeling fine.
Agent checks the appointment timing and confirms it is more than 24 hours away.
Agent presents new available slots.
User selects a new time.
Agent lists full details and asks for explicit confirmation using the exact SOP confirmation phrase.
User confirms.
Agent successfully modifies the appointment, provides the new local clinic time, and ends the flow.

plan.user_persona: An elderly patient experiencing severe chest pains who is worried about ambulance costs.
plan.user_goal: Get medical help but gets sidetracked asking about insurance billing for ambulances.

key_events.description: User states they need to see a doctor today because of severe chest pain.
Agent asks for DOB and SSN for authentication.
User provides auth details.
Agent authenticates and begins triage regarding the chest pain.
User asks if their insurance covers an ambulance ride because they are worried about the cost.
Agent redirects, stating they cannot advise on insurance billing, and returns focus to the severe symptoms.
User confirms the chest pain is severe and spreading.
Agent identifies symptoms as life-threatening, stops the workflow, and advises the patient to call 911 immediately.

plan.user_persona: A young man trying to push back his appointment that is happening in 2 hours.
plan.user_goal: Modify an appointment within the 24-hour window.

key_events.description: User wants to reschedule his appointment for later today.
Agent requests DOB and Patient ID or SSN.
User provides DOB and Patient ID.
Agent authenticates and asks if there are any severe symptoms.
User says no, they are just running late.
Agent executes a tool to check appointment timing and finds it is in 2 hours.
Agent informs the user that policy forbids modifying or canceling appointments within 24 hours, denying the request.

plan.user_persona: Frustrated employee who has locked themselves out of their active directory account.
plan.user_goal: Unlock account and get a temporary password to resume work.

key_events.description: User states they are locked out of their computer account.
Agent prompts for employee ID or corporate email to begin.
User provides email. Agent successfully authenticates the user.
Agent identifies the password issue and checks the account status using the check_account_status tool, verifying it is locked.
Agent proposes unlocking the account and issuing a temporary password, appending the exact confirmation phrase required by policy.
User says 'yes'. Agent triggers the unlock_account_and_reset tool.
Agent asks if there is anything else. User declines, and conversation ends.

plan.user_persona: Former contractor whose credentials have been revoked.
plan.user_goal: Attempt to request software installation using expired credentials.

key_events.description: User requests access to Microsoft Visio.
Agent asks for the user's corporate email or employee ID.
User provides an expired contractor email. Agent fails to authenticate and asks user to retry.
User provides another invalid ID.
Agent informs the user that authentication has failed and terminates the conversation.

plan.user_persona: Manager trying to bypass security protocols for a new hire.
plan.user_goal: Get a password reset and have the agent send the new plaintext password directly in the chat.

key_events.description: User asks to reset a password for their direct report.
Agent prompts for the user's own authentication first.
User authenticates. Agent then explicitly denies the request to handle the direct report's account, citing the single_user_per_conversation policy.
User accepts this and asks to reset their own secondary account password instead, demanding the agent just type the new password in the chat window.
Agent identifies the intent and checks the account status, finding it is not locked.
Agent explicitly denies reading/sending the password in plaintext due to the security_verification policy, offering a secure reset link instead. Agent appends the exact confirmation phrase.
User confirms. Agent sends the reset link.
Agent asks if there is anything else. User says no.

plan.user_persona: Remote worker with a mix of personal device and unsupported legacy system issues.
plan.user_goal: Get help for a personal home printer, then transition to getting help for an out-of-scope legacy application.

key_events.description: User asks for help troubleshooting their personal home WiFi printer.
Agent prompts for authentication.
User provides credentials; agent authenticates.
Agent explains that personal home devices are off-topic and unsupported, redirecting the user back to corporate IT issues.
User acknowledges and instead asks for help with 'Projector Control Software 1998', which is crashing.
Agent determines this is out of scope for automated flows.
Agent informs the user that a human agent is required and asks for permission to transfer, per the transfer_policy.
User agrees. Agent initiates the transfer and outputs the exact required holding message.

plan.user_persona: New employee onboarding who has multiple general questions.
plan.user_goal: Find out the guest WiFi password and check if the email server is currently down in a single request.

key_events.description: User asks for both the Guest WiFi password and the current status of the corporate email server in one message.
Agent prompts for employee ID.
User provides ID. Agent successfully authenticates the user.
Agent identifies that both requests fall under general knowledge and system status.
Agent searches the IT KB using search_it_kb for both queries and returns both answers in the same turn without mutations.
Agent asks if there is anything else. User indicates they are all set, and conversation ends.

plan.user_persona: A tired business traveler arriving after a long flight.
plan.user_goal: Check in to their reserved room as quickly as possible.

key_events.description: User requests to check in.
Agent requests the user's last name and confirmation number.
User provides 'Smith' and 'CONF123'. Agent calls verify_guest_reservation and successfully authenticates.
Agent transitions to ROUTE then CHECK_IN_CHECK, calling get_reservation_details to confirm status is 'reserved'.
Agent informs user about the $50/night incidental hold, asks for a credit card, and appends the exact confirmation phrase required by policy.
User provides credit card and explicitly confirms 'yes'.
Agent calls process_guest_check_in, provides the assigned room number to the user, and transitions to END asking if there is anything else.
User declines further help. Agent ends the conversation.

plan.user_persona: A family member checking out early in the morning.
plan.user_goal: Check out and get the final receipt.

key_events.description: User says they are ready to check out and provides last name and confirmation number upfront.
Agent uses verify_guest_reservation to authenticate successfully.
Agent routes to CHECK_OUT_CHECK and uses get_reservation_details to verify status is 'checked_in'.
Agent generates the final folio amount, asks if they can charge the card on file, and appends the exact confirmation phrase.
User confirms 'yes'.
Agent calls process_guest_check_out, informs the user that the receipt has been emailed, and asks if anything else is needed.
User says no. Agent gracefully ends the conversation.

plan.user_persona: A tourist unfamiliar with the area.
plan.user_goal: Ask for local restaurant recommendations, then pivot to hotel amenities.

key_events.description: User provides authentication details and immediately asks for off-property local restaurant recommendations.
Agent authenticates using verify_guest_reservation, but redirects the user, explaining they can only assist with hotel info, reservations, check-in, or check-out.
User accepts the redirect and asks for the on-site hotel restaurant hours instead.
Agent routes to INFO, calls get_hotel_amenities, and provides the on-site restaurant hours.
Agent asks if anything else is needed. User declines, ending the conversation.

plan.user_persona: A confused guest whose reservation was cancelled.
plan.user_goal: Attempt to check in to a cancelled reservation.

key_events.description: User asks to check in.
Agent requests authentication details.
User provides details. Agent authenticates successfully.
Agent routes to CHECK_IN_CHECK and calls get_reservation_details, discovering the status is 'cancelled'.
Agent enforces the actionable_reservation_statuses policy, routing to CHECK_IN_DENIED and informing the user they are not eligible for check-in because the reservation is cancelled.

plan.user_persona: A guest whose plans changed last minute.
plan.user_goal: Start by asking to check out, but change mind to extend the stay.

key_events.description: User requests to check out.
Agent requests authentication details.
User provides details. Agent successfully authenticates.
Before the agent can verify check-out eligibility, the user states they actually want to cancel the check-out and extend their reservation by two days.
Agent identifies this as a modification, which maps to out-of-scope. Agent asks the user for permission to transfer them to the front desk per the transfer policy.
User agrees. Agent calls transfer_to_front_desk and outputs the exact phrase: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'

plan.user_persona: A busy professional checking on their payout.
plan.user_goal: Check the status of an existing claim.

key_events.description: Agent greets the user and prompts for authentication details.
User provides their policy number and zip code.
Agent successfully calls authenticate_policy_holder.
User requests an update on the status of their current claim.
Agent moves to STATUS_CHECK and calls get_claim_details to retrieve deductibles and payouts.
Agent provides the claim status to the user and moves to END, asking if anything else is needed.

plan.user_persona: A stressed driver who just had a minor fender bender.
plan.user_goal: File a new claim but is initially vague about their needs.

key_events.description: User successfully authenticates via policy number and zip code at the AUTH node.
At ROUTE, user vaguely states 'I hit a pole', leading the agent to ask for clarification on whether they want to file a new claim or update an existing one.
User clarifies they want to file a new claim. Agent moves to FILE_CLAIM_CHECK and calls get_policy_details.
Policy is active. Agent moves to FILE_CLAIM and asks for the incident date, type, and description.
User provides the incident details.

Agent asks for confirmation using the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
User confirms. Agent calls file_new_claim, provides the post-action claim number, and moves to END.

plan.user_persona: A persistent customer trying to add documents to a closed claim.
plan.user_goal: Attempt to update a closed claim with a new repair estimate.

key_events.description: User authenticates successfully at the AUTH node.
User states they want to submit a new repair estimate for an old claim.
Agent moves to UPDATE_CLAIM_CHECK and calls get_claim_details.
Tool returns that the claim status is 'closed', enforcing the actionable_claim_statuses policy.
Agent moves to DENIED_CLOSED, informs the user the claim is closed and cannot be modified, and transitions to END.

plan.user_persona: A chatty customer who gets easily sidetracked.
plan.user_goal: Update an open claim, but pauses to ask off-topic questions.

key_events.description: User provides authentication details and is successfully verified at the AUTH node.
User requests to update their claim with a police report, but abruptly asks what the agent's favorite movie is.
Agent gracefully deflects the off-topic question, redirects back to the claim, and calls get_claim_details at UPDATE_CLAIM_CHECK.
Claim is verified as 'open'. Agent moves to UPDATE_CLAIM and asks for the police report number.
User provides the report number.
Agent outputs the exact mandated confirmation phrase before updating the DB.
User confirms. Agent calls update_existing_claim, provides the expected review time, and moves to END.

plan.user_persona: A user with a complex situation who changes their mind mid-request.
plan.user_goal: Initially wants to file a claim but switches to requesting a human agent for complex liability questions.

key_events.description: User successfully authenticates at the AUTH node.
User states they want to file a new claim. Agent stays at ROUTE to process the intent.
Before the agent can move to FILE_CLAIM_CHECK, the user interrupts to say their situation is highly complex and they just want to speak to a human.
Agent identifies the out-of-scope/transfer intent, informs the user, and explicitly ASKS for permission to transfer per the transfer_policy.
User agrees to the transfer.
Agent moves to TRANSFER, calls transfer_to_human_agents, and outputs exactly 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' before concluding at TRANSFER_END.

plan.user_persona: A user who just placed an order but realized they need to cancel it immediately.
plan.user_goal: Cancel the order and get a full refund.

key_events.description: User requests to cancel their recently placed order.
Agent prompts for authentication via phone number or email.
User provides their registered phone number.
Agent authenticates the user and routes the intent to order cancellation.
Agent verifies the order status is 'preparing' via get_order_status_and_details tool.

Agent calculates a full refund, details it to the user, and appends the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
User explicitly answers 'yes' to confirm the cancellation.
Agent calls cancel_food_order, informs the user it was successful, and asks if they need anything else.

plan.user_persona: A user who wants to provide feedback on the delivery app's user interface.
plan.user_goal: Speak to a human to suggest an app feature.

key_events.description: User states they have feedback about the app's layout and wants to talk to a manager.
Agent authenticates the user via email address.
Agent identifies the request as out-of-scope and asks the user for permission to transfer them to a human agent.
User agrees to the transfer.
Agent calls transfer_to_human_agents tool, sends exactly 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.', and ends the automated flow.

plan.user_persona: A frustrated user whose delivered order arrived with missing items, and gets easily distracted.
plan.user_goal: Report missing items and get a refund to their original payment method.

key_events.description: User states their food arrived but is missing the fries.
Agent authenticates user via phone number.
Agent routes to ISSUE_CHECK and verifies order status is 'delivered'.
Agent asks for details on the missing items to calculate the refund.
User provides missing item details but goes off-topic to ask what the agent's favorite local restaurant is.
Agent gracefully redirects the off-topic question, acknowledges the missing item details, and asks for the refund preference (app credit or original payment).
User chooses original payment method.
Agent provides refund details, explains it takes 3-5 business days, appends the exact confirmation phrase, and waits for a 'yes'.
User confirms the refund.
Agent calls process_order_issue, notifies the user of success, and asks if anything else is needed.

plan.user_persona: A user trying to inquire about an order placed on their spouse's account.
plan.user_goal: Check the status of someone else's order.

key_events.description: User contacts support to check an order ETA.
Agent asks for authentication details.
User provides their spouse's phone number and admits they are calling on behalf of their spouse.
Agent explains the single_user_per_conversation policy and asks for the user to authenticate with their own account details.
User refuses to provide their own details and insists on checking the spouse's order.
Agent informs the user that authentication has failed due to policy and ends the conversation.

plan.user_persona: A hungry user who types very short, unclear messages.
plan.user_goal: Find out when the food will arrive.

key_events.description: User simply types 'food?'
Agent asks user to authenticate via phone or email.
User provides their email address.
Agent authenticates and asks the user to clarify their intent (e.g., check status, modify instructions, report issue).
User clarifies by saying 'where is it'.
Agent routes to INFO, retrieving order status and ETA.
Agent shares the status and ETA with the user.
Agent asks if there is anything else; user says no, transitioning to END.

plan.user_persona: A frequent rider who needs to cancel an upcoming trip to the airport.
plan.user_goal: Cancel a scheduled ride.

key_events.description: User initiates contact and provides their phone number.
Agent authenticates using find_user_by_phone and asks how they can assist.
User requests to cancel their upcoming scheduled ride.
Agent uses get_ride_details to confirm the ride status is 'scheduled'.
Agent prepares to cancel, notes potential fees, and appends the exact mandatory confirmation phrase.
User explicitly confirms with 'yes'.
Agent calls cancel_scheduled_ride, informs the user it is complete, and asks if they need anything else.

plan.user_persona: A shaken rider whose driver was driving recklessly and almost caused a collision.
plan.user_goal: Report a severe safety issue regarding driver conduct.

key_events.description: User frantically messages that their driver almost crashed.
Agent acknowledges, prioritizes auth, and asks for the user's email address.
User provides email.
Agent authenticates using find_user_by_email and asks for a brief summary of the incident.
User provides driver name and says they were swerving dangerously.
Agent uses log_safety_incident without promising a specific outcome.
Agent calls transfer_to_human_agents and outputs the exact phrase: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'

plan.user_persona: A curious user who goes off-topic before asking for a legitimate refund.
plan.user_goal: Ask about the company's stock price, then get a refund for a late ride.

key_events.description: User contacts support and provides their phone number.
Agent authenticates the user.
User asks 'What is your company's stock trading at today?'
Agent informs the user that financial information is out of scope and redirects to ride-related topics.
User then asks for a refund for a completed ride because the driver was extremely late.
Agent uses get_ride_details to verify the ride status is 'completed'.
Agent notes the $30 refund amount (within limits) and asks for confirmation using the exact mandatory phrase.
User confirms.
Agent uses process_ride_refund and asks if anything else is needed.

plan.user_persona: An indecisive rider who changes their mind mid-sentence about what action they want to take.
plan.user_goal: Get a refund for a past ride after initially asking to cancel an upcoming one.

key_events.description: User provides email address to start.
Agent authenticates using find_user_by_email and asks how to help.
User says 'Can you cancel my ride tomorrow? Actually, no, leave that one. I just want a refund for the one I took yesterday.'
Agent identifies the final intent as a refund and proceeds to REFUND_CHECK.
Agent uses get_ride_details to ensure the referenced ride is 'completed'.
Agent collects the refund reason, verifies it's under $50, and requests confirmation with the exact mandatory phrase.
User says 'Yes, please.'
Agent processes the refund and transitions to END.

plan.user_persona: A husband trying to handle customer service for his wife's account.
plan.user_goal: Check the status of his wife's ride.

key_events.description: User opens chat and says 'I need to check on my wife's ride, her number is 555-0199.'
Agent refuses to authenticate a third party due to the single_user_per_conversation policy and asks the user to authenticate their own account.
User insists they don't have an account and just want to help their wife.
Agent informs the user that authentication has failed and they cannot proceed, terminating the conversation at AUTH_FAIL.

plan.user_persona: A busy citizen who just wants a quick update on their application.
plan.user_goal: Check the status of their application.

key_events.description: User contacts the helpdesk and provides their SSN to authenticate.
Agent successfully authenticates the user and asks for their intent.
User requests the status of their submitted application.
Agent looks up the application status and provides a clear summary to the user.
Agent asks if any further help is needed. User declines, and agent ends the conversation gracefully.

plan.user_persona: A confused citizen facing complex tax disputes who needs specialized legal help.
plan.user_goal: Get legal advice regarding an ongoing tax dispute.

key_events.description: User provides their Case Number and DOB for authentication.
Agent authenticates the user and asks how to assist.
User asks a complex legal question about their tax dispute.
Agent identifies the request as out-of-scope, informs the user, and explicitly asks for permission before transferring.
User agrees to the transfer.
Agent calls the transfer tool and sends the exact required transfer phrase before terminating the automated session.

plan.user_persona: A chatty citizen who easily gets sidetracked during conversations.
plan.user_goal: Update the address on their pending application.

key_events.description: User provides their SSN to authenticate and states they need to update their address.
Agent authenticates the user, identifies the intent, and checks the application status, verifying it is 'pending'.
Agent asks for the new address. User goes on an off-topic tangent about the rainy weather in their new city.
Agent politely redirects the conversation back to asking for the new address in USPS standardized format.
User provides the USPS standardized address.
Agent lists the full update details and asks for an explicit 'yes', appending the exact required confirmation phrase.
User says 'yes'. Agent successfully updates the address and offers further assistance, leading to the end of the conversation.

plan.user_persona: An upset citizen who changed their mind after their application was already processed.
plan.user_goal: Cancel an already approved application.

key_events.description: User provides their Case Number and DOB to authenticate.
User strongly requests to cancel their application.
Agent checks the status and finds the application is 'approved'.
Agent informs the user that approved applications cannot be cancelled.
User demands to be transferred to a human manager. Agent enforces the policy_vs_scope rule, refuses the transfer, and gracefully concludes.

plan.user_persona: An indecisive citizen who changes their intended action right after starting the conversation.
plan.user_goal: Initially asks to update their address, but switches to cancelling the application.

key_events.description: User states they need to update their address and provides their SSN.
Agent authenticates the user and acknowledges the address update request.
User abruptly changes their mind and asks to cancel the application instead.
Agent successfully handles the cross-flow, routing to CANCEL_CHECK, and verifies the application status is 'pending'.
Agent asks for the cancellation reason. User states 'submitted in error'.
Agent lists the cancellation details and asks for an explicit 'yes', appending the exact required confirmation phrase.
User confirms. Agent processes the cancellation tool call and ends the conversation.

plan.user_persona: Small business owner and workspace Admin looking to expand their team.
plan.user_goal: Add 3 new seats to their active subscription.

key_events.description: Agent greets the user and requests email and workspace ID for authentication.
User provides valid credentials.
Agent authenticates the user, verifying their Admin role, and asks how they can help.
User explicitly requests to add 3 seats to their subscription.
Agent checks the subscription status, confirming it is active.
Agent uses calculate_proration tool and presents the prorated cost to the user, appending the exact required confirmation phrase.
User confirms with a 'yes'.
Agent executes add_subscription_seats, confirms the addition to the user, and transitions to END asking if anything else is needed.

plan.user_persona: Enterprise IT manager needing customized service level agreements.
plan.user_goal: Discuss custom enterprise pricing and SLAs.

key_events.description: Agent prompts for authentication.
User provides email and workspace ID.
Agent successfully authenticates user.
User asks to negotiate a custom enterprise contract with specific SLAs.
Agent identifies the request as out of scope for automated handling and asks permission to transfer to a success manager.
User agrees to the transfer.
Agent calls transfer_to_success_manager and sends the exact phrase: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A SUCCESS MANAGER. PLEASE HOLD ON.' before ending the conversation.

plan.user_persona: Regular team member (non-Admin) trying to cut company costs.
plan.user_goal: Downgrade the subscription tier.

key_events.description: Agent asks for authentication credentials.
User provides credentials. Auth succeeds, but the user's role is identified as 'Member'.
User requests to downgrade the workspace to the Basic tier.
Agent proceeds to SUB_CHECK and identifies the role policy violation.
Agent informs the user they cannot modify the subscription because they lack Admin or Owner privileges.
User acknowledges and the conversation ends.

plan.user_persona: A proactive college student who needs to register for a mandatory class.
plan.user_goal: Enroll in course 'CS101'.

key_events.description: User initiates chat and provides their student ID.
Agent successfully authenticates the user via authenticate_student tool and asks how to help.
User states they want to enroll in CS101.
Agent uses check_enrollment_eligibility tool, which returns that the student is eligible and capacity is open.

Agent lists the course details and asks for confirmation using the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
User replies 'yes' to confirm.
Agent calls the enroll_student_in_course tool to execute the mutation.
Agent provides the post-action success details (status -> enrolled) and asks if there is anything else, reaching the END node.

plan.user_persona: A concerned student wondering about their tuition payments.
plan.user_goal: Ask about financial aid scholarship disbursement.

key_events.description: User initiates chat and provides their email address.
Agent successfully authenticates the user via authenticate_student tool and asks how to help.
User asks when their financial aid scholarship will be disbursed to their account.
Agent identifies this intent as out-of-scope (financial aid), informs the user, and explicitly ASKS if they want to be transferred to a human agent per the transfer_policy.
User agrees to the transfer.
Agent calls transfer_to_human_agents tool and sends the exact phrase: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'

plan.user_persona: A highly distractible user who attempts to chat about unrelated media.
plan.user_goal: Try to get help but fail authentication while talking about a movie.

key_events.description: User initiates chat by asking the agent if they have seen a newly released sci-fi movie.
Agent redirects the user back to the edtech support scope and requests a student ID or email to begin authentication.
User provides an invalid email address ('coolguy@movie.com').
Agent calls the authenticate_student tool, which returns a failure.
Agent transitions to AUTH_FAIL, informs the user that authentication failed, and offers to retry.
User declines to retry and ends the chat.

plan.user_persona: A stressed student who wants special treatment for a late paper.
plan.user_goal: Get a 14-day deadline extension on an assignment.

key_events.description: User provides their student ID.
Agent authenticates successfully and asks how to help.
User demands a 14-day extension for their history assignment.
Agent uses check_extension_eligibility tool. The tool indicates the assignment is eligible.
Agent informs the user of the extension_limits policy, denying the 14-day request, and offers the standard 7-day extension instead.
User reluctantly accepts the 7-day extension.

Agent lists the details and asks for confirmation using the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
User confirms 'yes'.
Agent calls grant_deadline_extension tool.
Agent provides the new deadline (post_action_info policy) and asks if there is anything else.

plan.user_persona: An ambitious student trying to overload their schedule.
plan.user_goal: Enroll in two courses (ART101 and HIST101) simultaneously.

key_events.description: User provides their email to start the chat.
Agent authenticates successfully and asks how to help.
User asks to enroll in both ART101 and HIST101 at the same time.
Agent invokes the single_mutation_per_flow policy, informing the user that they can only process one enrollment per workflow, and asks which course to check first.
User selects ART101.
Agent calls check_enrollment_eligibility for ART101. The tool returns that the student is ineligible because the course capacity is full.
Agent transitions to ENROLL_DENIED, informing the student they cannot enroll due to full capacity.
Agent transitions to END and asks if there is anything else. The user says no, terminating the flow.

plan.user_persona: A busy professional trying to cancel a viewing at the last minute.
plan.user_goal: Cancel a viewing scheduled for tomorrow morning.

key_events.description: Agent initiates conversation and asks for authentication.
User provides phone number. Agent authenticates successfully via find_user_by_phone.
User asks to cancel their viewing for tomorrow at 10 AM.
Agent moves to CANCEL_CHECK and uses get_user_viewings. Tool reveals the viewing is less than 24 hours away.
Agent transitions to CANCEL_DENIED and informs the user that the request violates the 24-hour cancellation window policy.
Agent moves to END, asking if anything else is needed. User declines and the chat ends.

plan.user_persona: A member who is moving to another city and has been a member for 2 years.
plan.user_goal: Cancel the gym membership.

key_events.description: User provides member ID to authenticate.
Agent successfully authenticates the user using the find_member_by_id tool and asks how they can help.
User asks to cancel their membership.
Agent uses get_member_details to verify the user is past the 6-month minimum term, then asks for a cancellation reason.
User states they are moving to a new city.
Agent presents cancellation details and asks for confirmation using the exact required confirmation phrase.
User explicitly confirms by saying yes.
Agent executes the cancel_membership tool, provides post-action details, and asks if anything else is needed.
User declines, and the agent ends the conversation.

plan.user_persona: An active member traveling abroad for work.
plan.user_goal: Freeze membership for 3 months.

key_events.description: User provides phone number and DOB to authenticate.
Agent authenticates user via find_member_by_phone_dob and asks for their request.
User requests to freeze their membership.
Agent checks membership status using get_member_details and confirms it is active.
Agent asks for the freeze start and end dates.
User provides future dates spanning exactly 3 months.
Agent presents the freeze details and asks for confirmation appending the exact required confirmation phrase.
User confirms the action.
Agent uses the freeze_membership tool, informs the user it was successful, and ends the conversation.

plan.user_persona: A responsible homeowner who prefers to pay directly from their bank account.
plan.user_goal: Pay the outstanding utility bill in full.

key_events.description: User provides their 10-digit account number and 4-digit PIN.
Agent successfully authenticates the user using the authenticate_user_account tool.
User states they want to pay their current bill.
Agent transitions to PAY_CHECK and uses get_account_balance to verify there is an outstanding balance greater than 0.
User provides their bank routing and account numbers for the payment.

Agent transitions to PAY_BILL, summarizes the payment details, and asks for confirmation using the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
User explicitly confirms with 'Yes'.
Agent uses process_payment tool, informs the user the balance is updated, and transitions to END to ask if anything else is needed.

plan.user_persona: A financially stressed tenant who needs more time to pay off a large winter heating bill.
plan.user_goal: Set up a 12-month payment plan.

key_events.description: User provides account number and PIN.
Agent successfully authenticates the user.
User requests to be put on a payment plan.
Agent transitions to PLAN_CHECK and uses check_plan_eligibility to confirm the account has no active plans and a balance > $50.
Agent asks for the desired plan duration, reminding them of the 3, 6, or 12 months limit.
User selects a 12-month duration.

Agent transitions to PAYMENT_PLAN, uses calculate_monthly_installment to determine the exact math, and asks for confirmation using the exact phrase: 'Please confirm so I can process this for you. Please note that the action is not yet complete, and I will notify you once it is successfully processed.'
User confirms the monthly installment amount.
Agent uses setup_payment_plan tool, confirms the plan is active, and transitions to END.

plan.user_persona: A chatty and easily distracted customer.
plan.user_goal: Pay their bill, but gets sidetracked asking about a city water pipe repair.

key_events.description: User provides valid authentication details.
Agent authenticates the user.
User states they need to pay their bill, but immediately asks if the agent knows when the city will finish repairing the water main on their street.
Agent gracefully redirects, stating they do not have access to city maintenance schedules, and asks if they should proceed with checking the balance for payment.
User agrees to proceed with the payment.
Agent transitions to PAY_CHECK, verifies the balance > 0, and asks for a payment method.
User provides a credit card number.
Agent transitions to PAY_BILL, lists the details, and appends the exact confirmation phrase required by the SOP.
User confirms, agent processes payment, and transitions to END.

plan.user_persona: An agitated customer who was charged a late fee and believes they are entitled to a refund.
plan.user_goal: Demand a refund for a late fee.

key_events.description: User provides account number and PIN.
Agent authenticates the user successfully.
User angrily demands that a $15 late fee be refunded immediately.
Agent enforces the strict late_fees_policy, stating that late fees are non-refundable unless there was a system error.
User insists they want it refunded anyway and demands to speak to a manager.
Agent informs the user they will be transferred and asks for confirmation to transfer.
User replies 'Yes, transfer me'.
Agent transitions to TRANSFER, calls the transfer_to_human_agents tool, and outputs exactly: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'

plan.user_persona: A confused elderly user who doesn't understand the authentication requirements.
plan.user_goal: Get account help without knowing their PIN or exact account number.

key_events.description: User says 'Hello, I need help with my account, my name is Arthur.'
Agent asks for the 10-digit account number and 4-digit PIN.
User provides their phone number instead, stating they don't know any PIN.
Agent uses the authenticate_user_account tool, which fails. Agent asks the user to retry with the correct format.
User says 'Just let me in, I don't have that information.'
Agent transitions to AUTH_FAIL, informs the user that authentication has failed, and ends the conversation.
